extracted.intended_audience: corporate filers, sponsors, offerors, and their counsel/accountants preparing SEC disclosure documents for roll-up transactions and mergers/acquisitions (Regulation S-K and Regulation M-A filings)
extracted.subtask_description: Requirements and itemized disclosure criteria from Regulation S-K (roll-up transactions) and Regulation M-A (mergers and acquisitions) specifying what information must be provided to security holders and the Commission in tender offers, mergers, roll-ups and related filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appraisal description clarity and form
rubrics_metrics.description: With respect to appraisals, a summary prepared by the appraisers should not be included in lieu of the description of the appraisals required by paragraph (c) of this Item (§229.911). A clear and concise summary description of the appraisals is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not substitute an appraiser-prepared summary for the required description; provide a clear and concise summary description of the appraisals as required by Item 911. (Citation: 56 FR 57247, 1991; amended 1994.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 912 — Source and amount of funds and transactional expenses (roll-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: State the source and total amount of funds or other consideration to be used in the roll-up transaction. Furnish a reasonably itemized statement of all expenses incurred or estimated to be incurred in connection with the roll-up transaction including, but not limited to, filing fees, legal, financial advisory, accounting and appraisal fees, solicitation expenses and printing costs. Identify the persons responsible for paying any or all of such expenses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include whether any partnership subject to the roll-up will be responsible for expenses and, if so, the amount from each partnership and the sources of capital. If consideration is expected to be provided by any partnership, state amounts by partnership and sources. If funds are borrowed by the sponsor/successor for the roll-up, provide a summary of each loan agreement (identity of parties, term, collateral, stated and effective interest rates, and other material terms) and briefly describe plans/arrangements to finance or repay such borrowing (or state none). If the source is an ordinary-course bank loan and Rules 13(d)/14(d) apply, the bank's name may be withheld from the public upon written request filed with the Secretary of the Commission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 913 — Other provisions of the transaction
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether appraisal rights are provided under applicable state law, under the partnership's governing instruments or will be voluntarily accorded; if so, summarize such appraisal rights. If appraisal rights will not be available, briefly outline rights which may be available under law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any provision allows investors access to partnership books and records or to obtain counsel or appraisal services at the expense of successor/general partner/sponsor, describe such provision. Discuss investors' rights under federal and state law to obtain a partnership's list of investors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 914 — Pro forma financial statements: selected financial data
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to Item 302 (§229.302), for each partnership proposed to be included in a roll-up provide: cash and cash equivalents; total assets at book value; total assets at the value assigned for purposes of the roll-up (if applicable); total liabilities; general and limited partners' equity; net increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents; net cash provided by operating activities; distributions; and per unit data for net income (loss), book value, value assigned for roll-up (if applicable), and distributions (separately identifying distributions that represent a return of capital) for the previous two fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide pro forma financial information (including oil & gas reserves and cash flow, if appropriate) assuming (1) all partnerships participate, and (2) participation by those partnerships that on a combined basis have the lowest combined net cash provided by operating activities for the last fiscal year, provided participation satisfies conditions. If combination of all partnerships results in lowest combined net cash, note that and no separate pro forma required. Pro forma statements must disclose effect of roll-up on successor's (1) balance sheet as of later of most recent fiscal year end or latest interim, (2) statement of income with separate line items to reflect income excluding and including roll-up expenses/payments, earnings per share, ratio of earnings to fixed charges for most recent fiscal year and latest interim, (3) statement of cash flows for most recent fiscal year and latest interim, and (4) book value per share as of later of most recent fiscal year end or latest interim. Instructions: omit information not material to exercise of prudent judgment; consider partial participation effects if roll-up permits participation by portions of partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 915 — Federal income tax consequences (roll-up)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief, clear and understandable summary of the material Federal income tax consequences of the roll-up transaction and an investment in the successor. Where a tax opinion has been provided, briefly summarize the substance of such opinion, including identification of material consequences upon which counsel has not been asked, or is unable, to opine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If material federal tax consequences differ for investors in different partnerships, describe differences. State whether the opinion of counsel is included as an appendix to the prospectus; if filed as an exhibit and not included in the prospectus, include a statement that upon written request by an investor (or designated representative) a copy of the opinion will be transmitted promptly without charge, naming the contact person and address.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1001 — Summary term sheet (Regulation M-A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide security holders with a summary term sheet that is written in plain English. The summary term sheet must briefly describe in bullet point format the most material terms of the proposed transaction and provide sufficient information to understand the essential features and significance of the proposed transaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Bullet points must cross-reference a more detailed discussion contained in the disclosure document disseminated to security holders. Instructions: do not recite all information contained in the disclosure document; the term sheet is intended as an overview of material matters. The summary term sheet must begin on the first or second page of the disclosure document. Refer to Rule 421(b) and (d) of Regulation C (§230.421) for plain English disclosure guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1002 — Subject company information
rubrics_metrics.description: State the name of the subject company (or the issuer in an issuer tender offer) and the address and telephone number of its principal executive offices. State the exact title and number of shares outstanding of the subject class of equity securities as of the most recent practicable date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify the principal trading market and state high and low sales prices (or bid quotation ranges) for each quarter during the past two years; state dividend frequency and amounts for past two years and any restrictions on ability to pay dividends. If the filing person has made underwritten public offerings in past three years, state date, amount, offering price per share (adjusted), and aggregate proceeds. If filing person purchased subject securities during past two years, state amount purchased, range of prices paid and average purchase price for each quarter. If no established trading market or limited quotations, so state. Securities outstanding may be based on most recent subject company filing unless filer has more current info.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1003 — Identity and background of filing person
rubrics_metrics.description: State the name, business address and business telephone number of each filing person and each person specified in Instruction C to the schedule. If the filing person is an affiliate of the subject company, state the nature of the affiliation; if the filing person is the subject company, so state.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For non-natural persons: state principal business, place of organization and provide additional information required by paragraphs (c)(3) and (c)(4). For natural persons: provide current principal occupation/employer and address; material occupations/positions during past five years with dates and employer names; statement whether convicted in criminal proceeding during past five years (excluding traffic violations) with description if convicted; statement whether party to judicial/administrative proceeding in past five years that resulted in injunction or finding of securities law violation with description; country of citizenship. Identify the tender offer and class of securities, name and address of offeror. Instruction: if information is made available on Internet, state the address where it can be found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1004 — Terms of the transaction
rubrics_metrics.description: State the material terms of the transaction. For tender offers, include: total number and class of securities sought; type and amount of consideration offered; scheduled expiration date; whether a subsequent offering period will be available (for third-party offers); whether the offer may be extended and how; dates before and after which holders may withdraw securities tendered; procedures for tendering and withdrawing; manner of acceptance for payment; if offer is for less than all securities, periods for accepting pro rata and offeror's intentions if oversubscribed; explanation of material differences in rights of security holders as a result of the transaction, if material; brief statement as to accounting treatment, if material; federal income tax consequences, if material.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For mergers or similar transactions, include brief description of transaction; consideration offered; reasons for engaging; vote required for approval; explanation of material differences in rights of security holders; brief accounting statement if material; federal income tax consequences if material. Instruction: if consideration includes securities exempt from registration, provide description complying with Item 202 of Regulation S-K unless exemptions apply. Also: state whether any securities are to be purchased from officers/directors/affiliates and provide details; describe any terms treating some holders differently; state whether dissenting security holders are entitled to appraisal rights and summarize them; describe any provisions to grant unaffiliated holders access to corporate files or counsel/appraisal services at filer expense (or state none); if transaction involves offer of filing person's securities in exchange for equity of subject company, describe steps to assure offered securities will be eligible for trading on automated quotation systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1005 — Past contacts, transactions, negotiations and agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly state the nature and approximate dollar amount of any transaction during the past two years between the filing person (including persons specified in Instruction C) and (1) the subject company or its non-natural-person affiliates if aggregate value >1% of subject company's consolidated revenues for the fiscal year when transaction occurred (or past portion of current fiscal year), and (2) any executive officer, director or affiliate natural person if aggregate value exceeds $60,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe any negotiations, transactions or material contacts during the past two years concerning mergers, consolidations, acquisitions, tender offers, director elections, or sale/transfer of material assets. Describe negotiations/material contacts during past two years between affiliates and any person not affiliated with subject company who would have direct interest. Identify person who initiated contacts/negotiations. If material, describe any agreement/arrangement/understanding and any actual or potential conflict of interest between filing person (or affiliates) and subject company or offeror. Instruction: if filing person is the subject company, disclosure not required if substantially same information previously filed and disclosed in a proxy/ report sent to security holders in past year, but the new document must refer specifically to that prior discussion and the information must be filed as an exhibit. Also describe any agreements involving subject company's securities (transfer/voting, joint ventures, loan/option arrangements, guarantees, giving/withholding proxies). Include info on pledged or contingent securities that would give another power to direct voting/disposition; no disclosure required about standard default provisions in loan agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1006 — Purposes of the transaction and plans or proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: State the purposes of the transaction. Indicate whether securities acquired will be retained, retired, held in treasury, or otherwise disposed of. Describe any plans, proposals or negotiations that relate to or would result in extraordinary transactions (merger/reorganization/liquidation), purchase/sale/transfer of material assets, material change in dividend policy or capitalization, change in board/management (including plans to change number/term/fill vacancies or change material employment terms), or other material changes in corporate structure or business (including changes requiring shareholder vote), delisting, termination of registration, suspension of filing obligations under Section 15(d), acquisition/disposition of additional securities, or changes to charter/bylaws that could impede acquisition of control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If filing person is the subject company, state whether it is engaged in negotiations in response to the tender offer relating to a tender offer or matters listed, and describe any transaction, board resolution, agreement in principle, or signed contract entered into in response. Instruction: if agreement in principle has not been reached and disclosure would jeopardize negotiations, disclosure of possible terms/parties is not required — indicating that negotiations are underway and in preliminary stages is sufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1007 — Source and amount of funds or other consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: State the specific sources and total amount of funds or other consideration to be used in the transaction. If a tender offer, disclose amount required to purchase the maximum amount of securities sought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State any material conditions to the financing and disclose alternative financing arrangements or plans in the event primary plans fail (or state none). Furnish a reasonably itemized statement of all expenses (filing, legal, accounting, appraisal fees, solicitation, printing) and state whether subject company has paid or will be responsible for paying any or all expenses. If funds are expected to be borrowed, provide a summary of each loan agreement/arrangement (identity of parties, term, collateral, stated and effective interest rates, and other material terms) and briefly describe plans or arrangements to finance/repay the loan (or state none). Instruction: if third-party tender offer and source is ordinary-course bank loan, bank name may be withheld from public if filer requests in writing and files request naming the bank with the Secretary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1008 — Interest in securities of the subject company
rubrics_metrics.description: State the aggregate number and percentage of subject securities that are beneficially owned by each person named in Item 1003 and by each associate and majority-owned subsidiary of those persons; give name and address of any associate or subsidiary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beneficial ownership determined in accordance with Rule 13d-3. Identify shares person has right to acquire. Information may be based on subject company's most recent filing unless filer has more current information. Information with respect to officers, directors and associates must be given to extent known after reasonable inquiry. Describe any transaction in the subject securities during the past 60 days including identity of persons effecting the transaction, date, amount, price per share, and where/how effected. Provide required transaction information for specified categories of persons (filing person, persons named in Instruction C, executive officers/directors/affiliates as applicable). If information not available at initial filing, obtain and file promptly (no later than three business days after initial filing) and if material disclose in manner reasonably designed to inform security holders; this preserves confidentiality to avoid misuse of inside information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1009 — Persons/assets retained, employed, compensated or used
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify all persons and classes of persons that are directly or indirectly employed, retained, or to be compensated to make solicitations or recommendations in connection with the transaction. Provide a summary of all material terms of employment, retainer or other arrangement for compensation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify any officer, class of employees or corporate assets of the subject company that has been or will be employed or used by the filing person in connection with the transaction and describe the purpose for their employment or use. Instruction: provide all information required by this Item except for information required by paragraph (a) of this section and Item 1007.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1010 — Financial statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish audited financial statements for the two fiscal years required to be filed with the company's most recent annual report under sections 13 and 15(d) of the Exchange Act; unaudited balance sheets, comparative year-to-date statements of comprehensive income and related earnings per share data and statements of cash flows required to be included in the company's most recent quarterly report; and book value per share as of date of the most recent balance sheet presented.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If material, furnish pro forma information disclosing the effect of the transaction on the company's balance sheet as of the most recent balance sheet date, the company's statement of comprehensive income and earnings per share for the most recent fiscal year and latest interim period, and the company's book value per share as of the most recent balance sheet date. Furnish a fair and adequate summary of the specified information for the same periods: summarized financial information specified in §210.1-02(bb)(1); income per common share from continuing operations (basic and diluted, if applicable); net income per common share (basic and diluted, if applicable); book value per share; and if material, pro forma data for summarized financial information disclosing the effect of the transaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Item 1011 — Additional information (agreements, regulatory requirements, legal proceedings, executive compensation disclosures)
rubrics_metrics.description: If material to a security holder's decision whether to sell, tender or hold securities sought in the tender offer, furnish: (1) any present or proposed material agreement, arrangement, understanding or relationship between the offeror or its officers/directors/controlling persons/subsidiaries and the subject company or its officers/directors/controlling persons/subsidiaries; (2) to the extent known after reasonable investigation, applicable regulatory requirements or approvals; (3) applicability of antitrust laws; (4) applicability of margin requirements under section 7 of the Act; and (5) any material pending legal proceedings relating to the tender offer with court/agency, date instituted, principal parties, brief summary and relief sought.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instruction: furnish promptly to Commission staff any document relating to a major development in a material pending legal proceeding. Also furnish information required by Item 402(t)(2) and (3) and in the tabular format of Item 402(t)(1) with respect to each named executive officer of the subject company in a Rule 13e-3 transaction or of the issuer in a third-party tender offer regarding any agreement or understanding concerning compensation (present, deferred or contingent) that is based on or relates to the transaction. Instructions include exemptions for foreign private issuers or emerging growth companies and quantification rules for computing amounts assuming triggering event occurred on latest practicable date, including valuation of in-the-money option awards.
